# Learning curve at 72 h and 168 h (generated by `scripts/run_long_learning_curve.py`)

Validation period only. XGBoost S4 and LSTM L4 with the long-horizon hyper-parameters, trained on the most recent 12 / 18 months and on the full training period; early stopping on validation for every size (mildly optimistic, identical procedure for all sizes); MAE in MW, mean of 3 per-seed MAEs. Descriptive, three sizes only.

## Horizon 72 h

| training data | samples | XGBoost S4 | LSTM L4 | LSTM / XGBoost |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 12 months | 8,757 | 5,550 | 6,159 | 1.11 |
| 18 months | 13,165 | 5,302 | 6,265 | 1.18 |
| full (28 months) | 19,803 | 4,904 | 5,597 | 1.14 |
